tool_input.command:
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
cd "$tmp"
git -C /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/rc2r2-d show b06f627:rotate.sh > rotate.sh
git -C /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/rc2r2-d show b06f627:verify.sh > verify.sh
git -C /Users/vitor/.cache/flashnext-concurrency/claude-work/rc2r2-d show b06f627:lib/log.sh > log.sh
mkdir -p lib && mv log.sh lib/
mkdir dest
for stamp in 20260101-000000 20260102-000000 20260103-000000; do
  echo "old $stamp" > "dest/demo-$stamp.tar.gz"
  (cd dest && shasum -a 256 "demo-$stamp.tar.gz" > "demo-$stamp.tar.gz.sha256")
done
echo "--- old rotate.sh --keep 3 with exactly 3 archives:"
bash rotate.sh --quiet --dest dest --name demo --keep 3; echo "rc=$?"
ls dest | grep 'tar.gz$'
printf 'payload\n' > "dest/my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz"
(cd dest && shasum -a 256 "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz" > "my backup-20260101-000000.tar.gz.sha256")
echo "--- old verify.sh with a space in the name:"
rc=0; out=$(bash verify.sh --quiet --dest dest) || rc=$?
echo "$out"; echo "rc=$rc"
cd - >/dev/null; rm -rf "$tmp"
tool_input.description: Reproduce both reported bugs against the original scripts
Remove scratch scripts and show changed files

result:
Done. Both bugs are fixed, one test added for each, and the shared parser + `resolve_dir` now live in `lib/common.sh` sourced by both scripts (all 12 tests pass; the new tests were verified to fail against the original code — `--keep 3` deleted the newest archive, and the space-named archive reported `BAD my (archive missing)`):

- **rotate.sh** — early exit now triggers at `total -le keep`, and surplus is the oldest `total - keep` entries (`head -n`) instead of `tail -n +"$keep"` which deleted the newest.
- **verify.sh** — sidecar line is split with `read -r expected file`, keeping spaces in the file name (the old `awk '{print $2}'` truncated it); digest comparison also quoted.
- **lib/common.sh** — new file with the shared option-parsing block and `resolve_dir`; `rotate.sh` and `verify.sh` source it, the other three scripts are untouched.
- **tests/run_tests.sh** — added the rotate rotation group and the verify space-in-name group.
